name: Dhoot Transmission Limited
summary: Dhoot Transmission Pvt. Ltd. makes wiring harnesses, automotive switches, electronic sensors and controllers, plus connectors, terminals, cables and power cords. Its harnesses go into two- and three-wheelers, commercial and off-road vehicles, farm and earth-moving machines, medical devices and household appliances. It also supplies electric vehicle products such as charging guns, inlets and off-board chargers.
